summary: SPAC Everest Consolidator Acquisition Corporation filed an 8-K on 2026-04-22 regarding stockholder-approved amendments to its trust agreement and certificate of incorporation to allow withdrawal of interest earned on the trust account after January 20, 2026 for permitted expenses. The amendment was approved at the April 15, 2026 meeting. 4,876,004 shares were entitled to vote; no deal price, premium, or advisor is stated. This is a routine trust amendment, not a business combination or liquidation event. No risk-arb angle; watch for any extension or completion deadline updates.
